text:
Maya (CS): drafting a short 'surge safety kit' for customers - single page they can keep handy during onboarding + renewal reviews. want feedback before i publish.
Alex (CS Ops): love the idea. pls include a tiny decision flow for tenant size (<=50k requests/day -> lightweight warm pool, >50k -> reserved warm pool + autoscale policy).
Priya (Solutions Eng): add a compact SDK example for client batching and a prefill curl. keeps customers from sending 1-token calls.
Maya (CS): good call. will keep examples tiny. also include a troubleshooting mini-faq.
Jordan (SRE): ops-safe notes: recommend client-side backoff with jitter and rate caps. Example in pseudocode: `backoff = base * 2^attempt + rand(0, jitter)`; cap attempts to avoid flood.
Sam (PM): include renewal-risk signals we surface to CS: sustained error rate >3% for 24h, user-visible p95 > 2x SLO for 6h, or failed prefill smoke test after a planned ramp. map those to green/yellow/red.
Lena (Legal): add a short line about telemetry opt-in and GDPR: "share anonymized telemetry only with written consent; we provide an opt-in template".
Priya (Solutions Eng): example snippets:
```bash
# prefill example
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/prefill \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"TENANT123","templates":["welcome","kb_summary"]}'
```
and batching config (SDK):
```json
{"batch": {"max_delay_ms": 50, "max_tokens": 2048}}
```
Maya (CS): streaming guidance?
Jordan (SRE): prefer chunked streaming for interactive UX. fallback plan: 1) attempt resume up to 2x; 2) if resume fails, serve cached partial text + enqueue full async generation and notify client. also suggest TTLs for prefill cache (e.g., 1-4 hours depending on churn). include note: "do not use unlimited shared cache".
Alex (CS Ops): small vs large tenant play: small tenants -> client prefill + short batch windows (10-100ms); large tenants -> server-side warm pools + batching windows 100-500ms for efficiency. include a one-line config customers can paste into onboarding doc.
Sam (PM): add a one-click checklist CS can send before renewals: warmpool enabled, prefill smoke test passed, telemetry sharing consent, spike runbook reviewed, fallback model ready.
Maya (CS): mini FAQ ideas: "p95 spikes during ramp -> check client batching, prefill TTL, noisy tenant circuit-breakers"; "stream disconnects -> check resume_attempts metric and network timeouts".
Priya (Solutions Eng): include a short sample Slack alert: `@channel CS-Alert: TENANT123 entered YELLOW - p95 x2 SLO; see dashboard link` and recommended routing `#cs-alerts` + `@oncall-sre`.
Lena (Legal): suggest an opt-in wording snippet for telemetry: "We may collect anonymized usage metrics to help tune performance. You may opt-in by signing this consent file".
CS Health Bot: created incident CS-2026-0911 for runbook annotation -> assigned Jordan (SRE). :robot_face: 
Maya (CS): thanks everyone. i'll assemble a single-page PDF + 1-page checklist and drop it in #customer-success tomorrow AM for quick reviews. feedback welcome in thread. :thumbsup:
